change.item: Joomla native updates now target the package only (pkg_devartvideo, site client)
Public update.xml no longer advertises the component as a separate update channel
PHP minimum for updates aligned to 8.3.0

fix.item: Missing or unpublished single videos return HTTP 404 instead of a listing fallback
Category descriptions use safe HTML on save and Joomla content prepare on output
Listing tag and featured query-string filters honour filter visibility
Administrator custom fields use WebAssetManager inline scripts

security.item: Public queries enforce access, language, and publish window visibility
Embed responses use private no-store cache headers and constrained CSP
Installer fails fast on schema errors instead of swallowing exceptions
Local media and thumbnail paths stay contained under the site root

addition.item: Frontend administrator, plugin, package, and module languages for fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, it-IT, and pt-PT
Video-specific JSON catalog backup in Tools
Latin FULLTEXT BOOLEAN prefix search on frontend listings

note.item: Install or update with the package ZIP once; later updates use Joomla native package updates
Component, module, and task plugin always update together through pkg_devartvideo

addition.item: Added full Joomla 6 native DevArt Video package
Added administrator component for managing video libraries
Added frontend video module
Added scheduled task plugin for maintenance and sync
Added video categories with unlimited hierarchy support
Added YouTube video support
Added local video support
Added featured videos support
Added responsive HTML5 video player
Added automatic thumbnail and poster image support
Added search, filtering and ordering options
Added complete JSON backup and restore
Added maintenance and cache management tools
Added GitHub-based Joomla update server support
Added automatic image optimization during upload
Added automatic image resize with configurable maximum dimensions
Added optional WebP image conversion
Added automatic safe filename generation for uploaded images

change.item: Video architecture designed specifically for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.3.0+
Optimized for editorial websites, news portals, video libraries and high-traffic environments
Video thumbnails uploaded through the component are automatically optimized while existing Media Manager images remain untouched
Video Settings and administrator tools follow the common DevArt component architecture for improved usability and consistency

security.item: Added ACL enforcement for administrator operations
Added CSRF protection for administrator actions
Added secure JSON import and export validation
Added parameterized database queries throughout the component
Added safe file upload validation and image processing
Added safe output escaping throughout frontend rendering

note.item: Initial public production release of DevArt Video
Built exclusively for Joomla 6 with PHP 8.3.0+
No database migration required for new installations
JSON backup and restore provides complete site portability
Native integration with DevArt Slider and DevArt Widgets
Always test upgrades on a staging environment before production deployment
